plan: Reduce QQQI to 20% to lower concentration and preserve capital.

conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and focuses on quality holdings, aiming for lower drawdowns.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to balance income and concentration.
Reduce exposure in weaker AI/Software (METU, PLTU) and Semiconductor (MUU) names.
Maintain small positions in leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) at 2% and 1% respectively.
Buy Apple (AAPL) at 4% as a quality tech addition.
This plan seeks risk-first growth by trimming weaker positions and adding quality.
A modest cash buffer is maintained for flexibility.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% monthly return with a risk-first mindset. It trims weaker positions, reduces leverage, and adds quality names, aiming for steady growth with controlled drawdowns.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to manage concentration while retaining some income.
Reduce exposure in CRWD to 6% to lock in some gains.
Exit broad index ETFs (SPY, QQQ) and weak Semiconductor (SMH) and AI/Software (METU) positions.
Add to SOXL, increasing leveraged ETF exposure to 6%.
This plan aggressively pursues growth by concentrating in high-conviction names and leverage.
Expect higher potential returns but also significantly larger drawdowns and leverage decay.
aggressive.read: This aggressive growth strategy targets around 4% monthly return by concentrating positions and increasing leverage, including in SOXL. It accepts higher risk and potential for larger drawdowns, with a smaller cash buffer. Leverage decay in ETFs is a key risk.

plan: Increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income generation.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and high-beta single names (METU, MSFU, PLTU, MUU).
Add SPY to 10% to provide a stable broad index component.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions over growth.
Focus is on capital preservation and reliable income streams.
Expect a lower target return of around 1% monthly, with minimal NAV volatility.
income.read: This income-focused strategy targets around 1% monthly return by prioritizing income-generating assets like QQQI and reducing riskier holdings. It aims for low drawdowns and consistent distributions, not capital appreciation.
